values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gliddenlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Glidden Lake State Forest Campground: 23 campsites, $20, managed by Bewabic SP), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in, carry-out: no trash barrels. Gravel boat launch on Glidden Lake in the day-use area.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gliddenlake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' values.note: 23 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (DNR wording, no length limit posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gliddenlake ('There are 23 sites for tent and small trailer use', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (23 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the east shore of Glidden Lake (29 acres, about 30 ft deep), 5.7 mi SE of Crystal Falls via M-69 (Iron County); managed by Bewabic State Park. Carry-in/carry-out (no trash barrels). Day-use area with a gravel boat launch and sandy shoreline; the Lake Mary Plains Pathway trailhead (9+ miles) is adjacent. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 23 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed, now manual). Season (Nov 1 - May 1 closure) already manual and matches the table. Phone 906-875-3324 matches (Bewabic SP). Note trimmed of field restatements.
